subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is correct about a protractor?

Statements:

1. A protractor can be used to measure angles from both sides.

2. A protractor is typically made of a rigid metal material.
solution:
__Explanation:__

Bevel Protractor

__
 
• A bevel protractor is also known as a plain protractor. It is a simple device mainly used for measuring and laying out angles.
 
• A protractor can be used to measure angles from both sides.
 
• It mainly consists of a head and a blade. the blade is about 150 mm long and the head is graduated from 0 to 180° in both directions for easy reading. Sometimes it is also called an engineer's protractor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbf5c2dc75f488a10bdceb0198a667a07d601974d3975838c14cb9a5e297d2f8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__Vernier bevel protractor__

__
 
• The vernier bevel protractor is a precision instrument meant for measuring angles to an accuracy of 5 minutes (5').
 
• It reads to 5 minutes or 1/12° and can measure any angle from 0° to 360°. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14571e14b7eb6f434ca5d8c944aa64efed39df8ee15583e2fa613c982ceefef9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4998aa63a35bcfc09323b9a7bc99e2be902ff64bd3f9f6f4701b02c494b0eb9.png] 

Parts of a vernier bevel protractor

 
• Stock:

 
 
• This is one of the contacting surfaces during the measurement of an angle
 
• Preferably it should be kept in contact with the datum surface from which the angle is measured
 
• It is normally used as a reference base for measuring an angle
 
 
 
• Dial:
 
 
• The dial is an integrated part of the stock
 
• It is circular in shape, and the edge is graduated in degrees
 
 
 
• Blade:
 
 
• This is the other surface of the instrument that contacts the work during the measurement
 
• It is fixed to the dial with the help of the clamping lever
 
• A parallel groove is provided in the centre of the blade to enable it to be longitudinally positioned whenever necessary
 
 
 
• Locking screws:
 
 
• Two knurled locking screws are provided, one to lock the dial to the disc, and the other to lock the blade to the dial
 
 

NOTE:__

 
• Range of bevel protractor = 0 to 180° 
 
• Range of Vernier bevel protractor = 0 to 360°
